I just built a Shiznit for the first time in over a year. I've been really happy with this indoor dual line #kite, and I think I'm ready to share the plans. So I've published the plans on my website, so folks are free to make this for themselves:
https://watty.us/kite-plans/2026/11/21/shiznit-plan
